```{r setup, include=FALSE}
required_packages <- c("flextable", "ggplot2", "knitr", "officer")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace,
                                              logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop("Required packages are missing; install them before rendering: ",
       paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = knitr::is_html_output(), warning = TRUE,
                      message = FALSE, comment = NA, out.width = "95%")
set.seed(params$seed)

if (length(params$ngroups) != 1L || !is.numeric(params$ngroups) ||
    is.na(params$ngroups) || !params$ngroups %in% c(2L, 3L)) {
  stop("params$ngroups must be numeric 2 or 3.")
}
analysis_groups <- if (params$ngroups == 2L) {
  c("Control", "Severe")
} else {
  c("Control", "Moderate", "Severe")
}
```

Synthetic participant-level example. Test choices and adjustment variables require approval before use in a study.

```{r synthetic-data}
make_example_data <- function(seed = 20261011) {
  set.seed(seed)
  group <- factor(rep(c("Control", "Moderate", "Severe"), each = 12),
                  levels = c("Control", "Moderate", "Severe"))
  group_index <- as.integer(group)
  sex <- factor(rep(c("Female", "Male"), 18),
                levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  family_history <- factor(rep(c("No", "Yes"), each = 18),
                           levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  outcome_lp <- -0.8 + 0.8 * (sex == "Male") + 0.9 * (family_history == "Yes")
  binary_outcome <- rbinom(36, 1, stats::plogis(outcome_lp))

  out <- data.frame(
    participant_id = seq_len(36),
    group = group,
    sex = sex,
    family_history = family_history,
    binary_outcome = binary_outcome,
    iop_mmHg = round(rnorm(36, c(14, 18, 22)[group_index], 2.2), 1),
    md_dB = round(rnorm(36, c(-1, -3, -5)[group_index], 1.5), 1),
    lens_status = factor(ifelse(group == "Control", "Clear",
                                ifelse(group == "Moderate", "Cataract", "Cataract")),
                         levels = c("Clear", "Cataract", "Other")),
    visual_field_class = factor(ifelse(group == "Control", "Normal", "Reduced"),
                                levels = c("Normal", "Reduced", "Unreliable")),
    laterality = factor(sample(c("Right", "Left", "Both"), 36, replace = TRUE),
                        levels = c("Right", "Left", "Both")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Deliberate, outcome-specific missingness for the example.
  out$iop_mmHg[c(5, 17)] <- NA_real_
  out$md_dB[c(3, 9, 15, 22, 30)] <- NA_real_
  out$laterality[c(7, 28)] <- NA
  out
}

dat_all <- make_example_data(params$seed)
dat <- dat_all[dat_all$group %in% analysis_groups, , drop = FALSE]
dat$group <- factor(dat$group, levels = analysis_groups)

stopifnot(nrow(dat_all) == 36L,
          identical(levels(dat$group), analysis_groups),
          all(table(dat$group) > 0),
          all(table(dat$sex) > 0),
          all(table(dat$family_history) > 0),
          all(rowSums(table(dat$sex, dat$binary_outcome)) > 0),
          all(rowSums(table(dat$family_history, dat$binary_outcome)) > 0))
```

```{r statistical-helpers}
continuous_specs <- data.frame(
  var = c("iop_mmHg", "md_dB"),
  label = c("Intraocular pressure", "Mean deviation"),
  unit = c("mmHg", "dB"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
categorical_specs <- data.frame(
  var = c("lens_status", "visual_field_class", "laterality"),
  label = c("Lens status", "Visual-field class", "Laterality"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("Not estimable")
  if (p < 0.001) return("<0.001")
  formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
}

fmt_mean_sd <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) < 2L) return("Not estimable")
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x), stats::sd(x))
}

fmt_median_iqr <- function(x) {
  if (!length(x)) return("Not estimable")
  qs <- stats::quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), names = FALSE,
                        na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f, %.1f)", qs[2], qs[1], qs[3])
}

continuous_p <- function(x, group, n_groups) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(group)
  x <- x[keep]
  group <- droplevels(group[keep])
  if (n_groups == 3L) {
    stats::kruskal.test(x ~ group)$p.value
  } else {
    stats::wilcox.test(x ~ group, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)$p.value
  }
}

categorical_p <- function(x, group) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(group)
  tab <- table(droplevels(x[keep]), droplevels(group[keep]))
  # Factor levels are displayed in full; empty margins are excluded only from
  # Fisher's test because they contain no observed information.
  tab_test <- tab[rowSums(tab) > 0, colSums(tab) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(tab_test) < 2L || ncol(tab_test) < 2L) return(NA_real_)
  stats::fisher.test(tab_test)$p.value
}

group_value <- function(x, group, level, fun) {
  fun(x[group == level & !is.na(x)])
}

group_n <- function(x, group, level) {
  sum(group == level & !is.na(x))
}

assert_group_counts <- function(x, group) {
  observed <- sum(!is.na(x))
  by_group <- sum(vapply(analysis_groups, function(g) group_n(x, group, g), integer(1)))
  stopifnot(observed == by_group)
  invisible(observed)
}

check_p <- function(p) {
  stopifnot(length(p) == 1L, !is.na(p), is.finite(p), p >= 0, p <= 1)
  invisible(p)
}
```

## Descriptive characteristics

```{r continuous-table, results='asis'}
make_continuous_block <- function(spec) {
  x <- dat[[spec$var]]
  assert_group_counts(x, dat$group)
  p <- check_p(continuous_p(x, dat$group, length(analysis_groups)))
  parent <- data.frame(
    row_type = "parent",
    summary = sprintf("%s (%s), N=%d", spec$label, spec$unit, sum(!is.na(x))),
    p = fmt_p(p),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  for (g in analysis_groups) {
    parent[[g]] <- sprintf("n=%d", group_n(x, dat$group, g))
  }
  child_mean <- data.frame(row_type = "child", summary = "\u00a0\u00a0Mean (SD)",
                           p = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  child_median <- data.frame(row_type = "child",
                             summary = "\u00a0\u00a0Median (p25, p75)",
                             p = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (g in analysis_groups) {
    child_mean[[g]] <- group_value(x, dat$group, g, fmt_mean_sd)
    child_median[[g]] <- group_value(x, dat$group, g, fmt_median_iqr)
  }
  out <- rbind(parent, child_mean, child_median)
  out[c("summary", analysis_groups, "p", "row_type")]
}

continuous_blocks <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(continuous_specs)), function(i) {
  make_continuous_block(continuous_specs[i, , drop = FALSE])
})
continuous_rows <- do.call(rbind, continuous_blocks)

make_categorical_block <- function(spec) {
  x <- dat[[spec$var]]
  assert_group_counts(x, dat$group)
  p <- check_p(categorical_p(x, dat$group))
  parent <- data.frame(
    row_type = "parent",
    summary = sprintf("%s, N=%d", spec$label, sum(!is.na(x))),
    p = fmt_p(p),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  for (g in analysis_groups) {
    parent[[g]] <- sprintf("n=%d", group_n(x, dat$group, g))
  }
  child <- lapply(levels(x), function(level) {
    row <- data.frame(row_type = "child",
                      summary = paste0("\u00a0\u00a0", level),
                      p = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for (g in analysis_groups) {
      n <- group_n(x, dat$group, g)
      count <- sum(x == level & dat$group == g, na.rm = TRUE)
      row[[g]] <- if (n == 0L) "" else sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", count, 100 * count / n)
    }
    row
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, c(list(parent), child))
  out[c("summary", analysis_groups, "p", "row_type")]
}

categorical_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(categorical_specs)), function(i) {
  make_categorical_block(categorical_specs[i, , drop = FALSE])
}))
```

```{r continuous-table-render, results='asis'}
make_publication_table <- function(rows, caption,
                                   first_label = "Outcome / summary",
                                   column_widths = NULL) {
  visible <- rows[setdiff(names(rows), "row_type")]
  names(visible)[names(visible) == "summary"] <- "Outcome / summary"
  if ("p" %in% names(visible)) names(visible)[names(visible) == "p"] <- "Unadjusted p"
  names(visible)[names(visible) == "Outcome / summary"] <- first_label

  ft <- flextable::flextable(visible)
  rule <- officer::fp_border(color = "#000000", width = 1)
  ft <- flextable::border_remove(ft)
  ft <- flextable::hline_top(ft, border = rule, part = "header")
  ft <- flextable::hline_bottom(ft, border = rule, part = "header")
  ft <- flextable::hline_bottom(ft, border = rule, part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::font(ft, fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::fontsize(ft, size = 10, part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::color(ft, color = "#000000", part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::bg(ft, bg = "#FFFFFF", part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::align(ft, j = seq.int(2, ncol(visible)), align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::padding(ft, padding = 3, part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::bold(ft, part = "header")
  if (is.null(column_widths)) {
    if ("Unadjusted p" %in% names(visible)) {
      group_width <- (6.3 - 2.4 - 0.9) / length(analysis_groups)
      column_widths <- c(setNames(2.4, first_label),
                         setNames(rep(group_width, length(analysis_groups)), analysis_groups),
                         setNames(0.9, "Unadjusted p"))
    } else {
      column_widths <- c(setNames(2.4, first_label),
                         setNames(c(0.6, 0.8, 1.25, 1.25), names(visible)[2:5]))
    }
  }
  for (column in names(column_widths)) {
    ft <- flextable::width(ft, j = column, width = unname(column_widths[[column]]))
  }
  ft <- flextable::set_table_properties(
    ft, layout = "fixed", width = 1,
    opts_word = list(split = FALSE, repeat_headers = TRUE)
  )
  ft <- flextable::padding(ft, i = which(rows$row_type == "child"), j = 1,
                           padding.left = 12, part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::paginate(ft, init = TRUE, hdr_ftr = TRUE)
  parent_rows <- which(rows$row_type == "parent")
  ft <- flextable::bold(ft, i = parent_rows, j = seq_len(ncol(visible)),
                        bold = TRUE, part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::set_caption(ft, caption)
  ft
}

descriptive_rows <- rbind(continuous_rows, categorical_rows)
make_publication_table(descriptive_rows,
                       "Table 1. Descriptive characteristics by comparison group")
```

p: `r if (params$ngroups == 3) "Kruskal–Wallis" else "asymptotic Wilcoxon rank-sum"` (continuous); Fisher's exact (categorical).

## Binary outcome associations

```{r regression-helpers}
regression_predictors <- data.frame(
  var = c("sex", "family_history"),
  label = c("Sex", "Family history"),
  reference = c("Female", "No"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

regression_data <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, c("binary_outcome", regression_predictors$var),
                                           drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
regression_n <- nrow(regression_data)
stopifnot(regression_n > 0L,
          all(table(regression_data$binary_outcome) > 0))

fit_univariable <- lapply(regression_predictors$var, function(variable) {
  stats::glm(stats::reformulate(variable, response = "binary_outcome"),
             data = regression_data, family = stats::binomial())
})
names(fit_univariable) <- regression_predictors$var
fit_multivariable <- stats::glm(
  stats::reformulate(regression_predictors$var, response = "binary_outcome"),
  data = regression_data, family = stats::binomial()
)

# Fail before printing a model that did not converge or dropped terms.
all_fits <- c(fit_univariable, list(fit_multivariable))
stopifnot(all(vapply(all_fits, function(fit) {
  isTRUE(fit$converged) && !isTRUE(fit$boundary) &&
    stats::nobs(fit) == regression_n &&
    all(is.finite(stats::coef(fit))) && all(is.finite(stats::vcov(fit)))
}, logical(1))))

null_fit <- stats::glm(binary_outcome ~ 1, data = regression_data,
                       family = stats::binomial())
model_ll <- as.numeric(stats::logLik(fit_multivariable))
null_ll <- as.numeric(stats::logLik(null_fit))
model_lr <- 2 * (model_ll - null_ll)
model_df <- attr(stats::logLik(fit_multivariable), "df") -
  attr(stats::logLik(null_fit), "df")
model_p <- stats::pchisq(model_lr, df = model_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
model_neg2ll <- -2 * model_ll
model_pseudo_r2 <- 1 - model_ll / null_ll
stopifnot(isTRUE(null_fit$converged), is.finite(model_neg2ll),
          model_df > 0, model_lr >= 0, is.finite(model_pseudo_r2))

wald_or <- function(fit, term) {
  beta <- stats::coef(fit)[term]
  ci <- stats::confint.default(fit, parm = term, level = 0.95)
  stopifnot(is.finite(beta), all(is.finite(ci)),
            all(is.finite(exp(c(beta, ci)))), all(exp(c(beta, ci)) > 0))
  sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", exp(beta), exp(ci[1]), exp(ci[2]))
}

outcome_percent <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(x == 1L))
}
```

```{r regression-table, results='asis'}
make_regression_block <- function(spec) {
  x <- regression_data[[spec$var]]
  univariable_fit <- fit_univariable[[spec$var]]
  parent <- data.frame(
    row_type = "parent",
    summary = spec$label,
    N = as.character(length(x)),
    `Outcome=1 (%)` = outcome_percent(regression_data$binary_outcome),
    `Univariable OR [95% CI]` = "",
    `Multivariable OR [95% CI]` = "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  children <- lapply(levels(x), function(level) {
    reference <- identical(level, spec$reference)
    n <- sum(x == level)
    y <- regression_data$binary_outcome[x == level]
    row <- data.frame(
      row_type = "child",
      summary = paste0("\u00a0\u00a0", level,
                       if (reference) " (Reference)" else ""),
      N = as.character(n),
      `Outcome=1 (%)` = outcome_percent(y),
      `Univariable OR [95% CI]` = if (reference) "1.00 [Reference]" else {
        wald_or(univariable_fit, paste0(spec$var, level))
      },
      `Multivariable OR [95% CI]` = if (reference) "1.00 [Reference]" else {
        wald_or(fit_multivariable, paste0(spec$var, level))
      },
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    row
  })
  do.call(rbind, c(list(parent), children))
}

regression_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(regression_predictors)), function(i) {
  make_regression_block(regression_predictors[i, , drop = FALSE])
}))

make_publication_table(
  regression_rows,
  sprintf("Table 3. Binary outcome=1 associations (complete model sample N=%d)", regression_n),
  first_label = "Variable / category",
  column_widths = c("Variable / category" = 2.4, N = 0.6, `Outcome=1 (%)` = 0.8,
                    `Univariable OR [95% CI]` = 1.25,
                    `Multivariable OR [95% CI]` = 1.25)
)
```

95% Wald CIs. Multivariable model includes sex and family history.

Multivariable model: N=`r regression_n`; LR χ²(`r model_df`)=`r sprintf("%.2f", model_lr)`, p=`r fmt_p(model_p)`; −2LL=`r sprintf("%.2f", model_neg2ll)`; McFadden pseudo-R²=`r sprintf("%.3f", model_pseudo_r2)`.
